mapper.sql: id, thing_id, group_id, completed_by, completed_at, note
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO things_completion (thing_id, group_id, completed_by, completed_at, note) VALUES (#{thingId}, #{groupId}, #{completedBy}, #{completedAt}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM things_completion WHERE thing_id = #{thingId} AND (group_id = #{groupId} OR (group_id IS NULL AND completed_by = #{userId})) LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM things_completion WHERE group_id = #{groupId} OR (group_id IS NULL AND completed_by = #{userId}) ORDER BY completed_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM things_completion WHERE group_id = #{groupId} OR (group_id IS NULL AND completed_by = #{userId})
